name: fp6_e2m3
description: Default with fp6 E2M3 operands sent as 4-bit indices into 6-bit LUTs. The LUTs are made as the compiler always has: one per 2 rows of A / columns of B / rows of C (G = 1), B and A fitted by k-means to their own codes, a chained stage's C fitted to an fp32 estimate of its output, indices picked by value on the host.
